food_culture: There is enough to eat, if nobody asks for much more than the day needs.
commoner_resentments: Many here feel that the Free Elder Council no longer listens to people like them.
outsider_impressions: A visitor soon learns that little happens here without the Free Elder Council. People here keep an eye on the wild country and mention it often. The sick are not well provided for here, and a visitor notices it.
dawn_work: Before anyone goes out to work, each household looks to its own door and sees that all is as it was left.

food_culture: What the hunters bring home goes into the common pot, and it stretches a long way.
commoner_resentments: There is little trust here that the Elder Council will do right by ordinary people.
outsider_impressions: Nothing of weight is agreed here without the leave of the Religious Authorities. Living this near the wild has made people watchful, and a visitor notices it. A visitor who needs a ruling or a permission should expect to wait for it.
dawn_work: The first light goes to walking the edges of the fields; the ordinary work begins once that is done.

food_culture: The place still eats from what was put by, and nobody wastes a crumb of it.
commoner_resentments: People put up with the Elder Council, but they expect little of it.
outsider_impressions: Whatever a visitor wants done, the Religious Authorities have a say in it. This is frontier country, and people speak of the wild beyond as close at hand. Matters brought to the Elder Council pile up faster than they are settled.
dawn_work: The first light goes to walking the edges of the fields; the ordinary work begins once that is done.

food_culture: The better-off eat well, and the rest eat plainly but enough.
commoner_resentments: Many here feel that the Feudal Stewardship no longer listens to people like them.
outsider_impressions: The Religious Authorities carry the most weight here, and nobody pretends otherwise. The wild is not far off, and visitors hear stories of what comes out of it. Getting anything decided here takes time, for those who decide are few and busy.
dawn_work: Before the day's work begins, someone looks out over the country around to see that nothing is stirring.
